```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 300
)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  here, ggplot2, dplyr, scales, dampack
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
# Panel A: Model B (focused) - base case pricing
psa_B_file <- here("data", "tidy", "psa_obj_focused.rds")
# Panel B: Model A (joint) - base case pricing
psa_A_file <- here("data", "tidy", "psa_obj_joint.rds")
# Panel C: Model B (focused) - biosimilar pricing (from scenario EVPPI cache)
scenario_cache_file <- here("data", "tidy", "scenario_evppi_results.rds")

psa_B <- if (file.exists(psa_B_file)) readRDS(psa_B_file) else NULL
psa_A <- if (file.exists(psa_A_file)) readRDS(psa_A_file) else NULL

# Extract biosimilar PSA from scenario cache
psa_biosim <- NULL
if (file.exists(scenario_cache_file)) {
  evppi_cache <- readRDS(scenario_cache_file)
  psa_biosim <- tryCatch(
    evppi_cache$all_model_scenario_results$focused$s1_decreased_nivo$psa_obj,
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Could not extract biosimilar PSA from scenario cache:", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
}

panels_loaded <- sum(!is.null(psa_B), !is.null(psa_A), !is.null(psa_biosim))
cat("Loaded", panels_loaded, "of 3 PSA objects\n")
if (is.null(psa_B)) cat("  Missing: Model B PSA cache\n")
if (is.null(psa_A)) cat("  Missing: Model A PSA cache\n")
if (is.null(psa_biosim)) cat("  Missing: Biosimilar scenario PSA (run 14_scenario_EVPPIs.R)\n")
```

```{r calculate-ceacs, include=FALSE}
wtp_range <- seq(0, 100000, by = 2000)
ceac_data <- data.frame()

# Panel A: Model B
if (!is.null(psa_B)) {
  ceac_B <- tryCatch(dampack::ceac(wtp = wtp_range, psa = psa_B), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(ceac_B)) {
    ceac_B$Panel <- "A: Model B"
    ceac_data <- rbind(ceac_data, ceac_B)
  }
}

# Panel B: Model A
if (!is.null(psa_A)) {
  ceac_A <- tryCatch(dampack::ceac(wtp = wtp_range, psa = psa_A), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(ceac_A)) {
    ceac_A$Panel <- "B: Model A"
    ceac_data <- rbind(ceac_data, ceac_A)
  }
}

# Panel C: Model B (Biosimilar)
if (!is.null(psa_biosim)) {
  ceac_biosim <- tryCatch(dampack::ceac(wtp = wtp_range, psa = psa_biosim), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(ceac_biosim)) {
    ceac_biosim$Panel <- "C: Biosimilar pricing (Model B)"
    ceac_data <- rbind(ceac_data, ceac_biosim)
  }
}

cat("CEAC data rows:", nrow(ceac_data), "\n")
```

```{r create-ceac-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
if (nrow(ceac_data) > 0) {
  # Strategy labels
  strategy_labels <- c(
    "control" = "Control (FLOX only)",
    "crp" = "CRP Strategy",
    "tlr" = "TLR Strategy",
    "tmb_braf" = "TMB/BRAF Strategy"
  )

  ceac_data$Strategy <- factor(
    ceac_data$Strategy,
    levels = names(strategy_labels),
    labels = strategy_labels
  )

  # Order panels: A (Model B), B (Model A), C (Biosimilar)
  ceac_data$Panel <- factor(
    ceac_data$Panel,
    levels = c("A: Model B", "B: Model A", "C: Biosimilar pricing (Model B)")
  )

  strategy_colors <- c(
    "Control (FLOX only)" = "gray50",
    "CRP Strategy" = "#E69F00",
    "TLR Strategy" = "#009E73",
    "TMB/BRAF Strategy" = "#0072B2"
  )

  ceac_plot <- ggplot(ceac_data, aes(x = WTP, y = Proportion, color = Strategy)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~Panel, ncol = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 51000, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_currency(
        prefix = "\u20AC", scale = 0.001, suffix = "K", big.mark = ","
      ),
      breaks = seq(0, 100000, by = 20000)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = strategy_colors, name = "Strategy") +
    labs(
      x = "Willingness-to-Pay Threshold (EUR/QALY)",
      y = "Probability of Being Cost-Effective"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

  print(ceac_plot)
} else {
  cat("No CEAC data available. Please run scripts 12_PSA.R and 14_scenario_EVPPIs.R first.\n")
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (nrow(ceac_data) > 0) {
  figs_dir <- here("figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) {
    dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  ggsave(
    filename = here("figs", "figure4.png"),
    plot = ceac_plot,
    width = 10,
    height = 12,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "figure4.png"), "\n")
}
```

Figure 4 has been saved to `figs/figure4.png`.
